answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 25 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The kernel register is checked at draw time, atlas lists the eligible set, and bridge seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 25 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 326 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
